fields.description: The exact name of the field variable sent by Tilda (case-sensitive, e.g., 'Name', 'Email', 'phone', 'custom_field').
fields.label: Tilda Field Name

fields.description: The corresponding fieldname in the selected Target Doctype.
fields.label: Frappe Field Name

fields.description: Choose how to handle multiple Tilda fields (comma-separated) mapped to one Frappe field. 'Overwrite': Use the first non-empty value found. 'Concatenate': Join all non-empty values with a space (best for text fields).
fields.label: Behavior for Multiple Tilda Fields

fields.description: The character(s) used to join values when 'Concatenate' behavior is selected (e.g., space, comma, | ). Defaults to a single space.
fields.label: Concatenation Delimiter
